name: signal_triage
purpose: Score a trace excerpt: real pattern or noise, which subsystem to focus next.
state_template: TRACE EXCERPT: <source session, time window, the events or aggregates observed, what normal looks like for this app>.

real_pattern.instructions: Does this excerpt show a genuine performance or failure pattern, rather than normal noise?

subsystem.instructions: Which subsystem should the next pull focus on?

criteria.kernel_net: Kernel network — TCP connections per PID
criteria.other: Some other subsystem described in the state

criteria.hand_to_fr: Hand to rmagent-fr with a work id for a hop-to-hop walk
criteria.capture_more: Widen or refine the ring capture and pull again
criteria.record: No pattern — record and move on
